items.summary: Update backend leaderboard timeframe filtering so the Weekly and Monthly filters return only results inside the intended day windows by comparing integer day IDs (the same day IDs used when recording results) instead of comparing nanosecond timestamps.

Ensure recording and removing results (recordDailyWin/recordDailyLoss/decrementDailyLog) continue to work without requiring any data migration, and the corrected timeframe filtering works immediately for existing stored daily logs.
